messages:
Alex K.: heads-up — onboarding LangChain runner contribs for the redwood-runner integration. Need a quick handshake: runner API + gateway routing + docs + joint announcement? Thoughts?

Jia L.: sounds good. can we make a one-pager checklist? include version pinning (langchain v0.3.x), example notebooks, and a smoke harness.

Morgan P.: technical blockers: 1) auth mapping (per-tenant api key) 2) streaming semantics alignment (LangChain's callback handlers) 3) KV cache compatibility for long-chat use. Also CI for model variants.

Samir R.: from HW partner side: make sure quantized model support is validated (int8/4), and provide a small perf matrix for nvidia A100 vs H100 vs AWS Trn1. Emphasize memory/kv cache implications.

Olivia T.: marketing ask: if partners want a joint blog/announce, need logos, co-bylines, and legal signoff. let's not schedule until we have integration milestone (demo + CI green). Also set embargo.

Integrations Bot: Build passed: https://ci.redwood.dev/runner-integ/2123 ✅ PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/rw/runner-contrib/pull/42

Jia L.: sketch of adapter config:

```yaml
adapter:
  name: redwood-runner
  endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/v1/run
  auth: { api_key: "REDACTED", tenant_header: "X-RW-TENANT" }
  streaming: true
```

Alex K.: action items:
- Jia to own adapter README + example notebook (due Tue)
- Morgan to add CI smoke and test matrix (due Thu)
- Samir to supply perf table and quantization notes (ASAP)
- Olivia to draft go/no-go for announcement (needs legal contact). Ping me once PR is green.

Morgan P.: noted. I'll add a nightly job to run smoke against quant models; need sample prompt set from product.

Jia L.: I'll create a tiny demo repo and link. Also will add a quickstart snippet for LlamaIndex usage.

Alex K.: thanks — let's sync Wed 10am for a 15m handshake. @Olivia T. can you invite marketing + legal? :calendar:

Olivia T.: on it. invite sent. :+1:

Integrations Bot: Reminder: deploy window Thurs 02:00 UTC — opt-in required for partner demos.

Alex K.: closing: will update thread with PR and demo link. Thanks everyone.
